title: Concrete evaluation of homogeneous continuous cochains
statement: Let $G$ be a compact Hausdorff topological group in universe $u$, and $N$ a topological integer representation in coefficient universe $\max(u,s)$ with discrete coefficient topology. Define $E_m$ on $m$ iterated continuous-map spaces recursively by $E_0(x)(())=x$ and $E_{m+1}(f)(h)=E_m(f(h_0))(h_1,\ldots,h_m)$. Define the additive map $e_n:H^n\to\operatorname{LC}(G^n,N)$ by $e_n(x)(g)=E_{n+1}(x)(1,g_0,g_0g_1,\ldots,g_0\cdots g_{n-1})$. Joint continuity of evaluation and finite products makes these functions locally constant. The iterated action uncurries to the diagonal action, so for invariant $x$, $E_{n+1}(x)(a h)=\rho(a)E_{n+1}(x)(h)$.
